name: Maybe Finance
description: A modern, open-source personal finance and wealth management tool. Originally a venture-backed startup, it was open-sourced and relies on a clean, modern tech stack focused on comprehensive net-worth tracking.

name: Actual Budget
description: A privacy-focused, local-first personal finance app that uses the envelope budgeting methodology. Features end-to-end encryption and multi-device synchronization.

name: Firefly III
description: A comprehensive, self-hosted personal finance manager featuring a strict double-entry bookkeeping system, expansive rule engine, and advanced reporting capabilities.

name: Ghostfolio
description: A lightweight, privacy-first open-source wealth management software built with a modern Angular and NestJS web stack.

name: Finlynq
description: An open-source personal finance app built with a first-party Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, allowing AI clients to query and manage finances.

name: Securo
description: A self-hosted, privacy-first personal finance manager that natively integrates bank syncing and self-hosted AI agents.

name: Go Money
description: An open-source personal finance manager written in Go, built for speed and advanced customization via Lua scripting.
